items.title: Kepler Astrologers Toastmasters Presents: Jupiter in Leo Through The Houses
items.summary:
Join Kepler Astrologers Toastmasters in this wonderful presentation of Jupiter in Leo through the houses!

1st House & Historic Perspective on Jupiter-Pluto opposition: Norma Jean Ream
Norma Jean has studied astrology for over 55 years. Her Kepler studies included the cross-cultural exploration of western and Vedic systems, as well as Classical and Hellenistic systems of astrology.
Website: http://astrologyhawaii.com
facebook/normajeanream  
facebook/astrologyhawaii

3rd House & Pluto-opposes-Jupiter: Sula Porter
Sula Porter has been studying Hellenistic Astrology with Adam Elenbaas at The Nightlight School since 2020. With a background in Information Technology Sula likes to study the history of innovations and their astrolgical correlations.
Website: https://infoage-astrology.com/
Instagram:  @socalsula

4th House & Jupiter in Leo intro: Christina Montsma
Christina Montsma is an astrologer and interdisciplinary researcher who integrates modern psychological, Hellenistic, and Vedic astrology with philosophy, psychology, and history to illuminate patterns of personal growth and societal transformation.
Website: https://www.christinamontsma.com/
Substack: https://christinamontsma.substack.com/ 
YouTube: https://www.youtube.com/@Christina.Montsma/videos 
IG: https://www.instagram.com/christina.montsma/ 
BlueSky: https://bsky.app/profile/christinamontsma.bsky.social 
X: https://x.com/ChristinaMonts2


5th House & Closing Blessing: Amélie Gebhard
Amélie Gebhard is a Berlin-based astrologer, artist, and speaker. Her work integrates psychological, evolutionary, and archetypal astrology to help people discover their creative potential as part of the human experience - with clarity and compassion.
Website: www.thestarsweare.com
instagram.com/thestarsweare

6th House & Jupiter Intro: Sinem Ayhan
Sinem Ayhan is an Istanbul-based astrologer and certified translator. She studies at Kepler College and AstroArt School of Astrology, with a special interest in traditional astrology, predictive techniques, and thoughtful, client-centered consultation.
Instagram: instagram.com/sinem_ozsen_ayhan/
Facebook: facebook.com/sinem.ozsen.ayhan
 
7th House & Chiron-Jupiter: Isil Karabulut
Isil is an architect and astrologer specializing in AstroMapping, with multiple roles at Kepler College including Course Builder, Teaching Assistant,  and Graphic Developer for Kepler College App.
Website: https://pinchoffate.com
https://www.instagram.com/ms.darkcloud_/

9th House & Nodal Axis Shift: Andrew B. Watt
Andrew B. Watt is an astrologer, poet, and artist working in western Massachusetts.  Consulting with clients since 2017, he works primarily with Hellenistic, Arabic and medieval European techniques.
Website: http://andrewbwatt.com.
https://bsky.app/profile/andrewbwatt.bsky.social 
https://www.instagram.com/abwatt42/ 
https://www.youtube.com/@ABWatt

10th House & Leo Intro: Brandon Hansen
Brandon is a stargazer from the Southwest US, and teaches Astronomy for Kepler College. Today he'll be using a Medeval style square chart to demonstrate Jupiter in the 10th, but he identifies as Metamodern Astrologer. 
Website: www.annularastro.space
https://www.instagram.com/brandonsupintheskyagain/
https://www.facebook.com/AnnularAstro, https://www.facebook.com/groups/astronomy4astrologers

11th House & Nodal Axis Shift: Sue Minahan
Sue hosts Talk Cosmos weekly astrological conversations awakening soul consciousness since 2018 across YouTube, Facebook, Radio, Podcasts. She's an Evolutionary Astrologer, Consultant, Vibrational Astrology student, Speaker, Writer, Mythologist, Musician, Artist.
Website:www.talkcosmos.com 
https://www.youtube.com/@TALKCOSMOS, https://www.facebook.com/talkcosmos, https://www.facebook.com/sue.minahan.33, https://www.instagram.com/talkcosmos,

12th House & Jupiter in Leo Intro: Courtney Goldstein
Courtney Goldstein integrates Evolutionary Astrology, the Akashic Records, and intuitive guidance to help people live with greater courage, self-love, and connection to their soul. She is passionate about making astrology practical and empowering for everyday life.
Website: www.lovecourtney.com
https://open.substack.com/pub/lovecourtney
https://youtube.com/@LoveCourtneyXOXO?si=u_MMm9oE3MYIKyUl

Moderator: Meghna Bhagat
Meghna Bhagat is an astrologer and experiential facilitator offering consultations and astro-drama based experiential work. She teaches Kepler's Speak to Shine course, with a new cohort starting October 26, 2026.

items.title: August Astrology Forecast 2026
items.summary:
A deep dive into the astrology forecast for August 2026, with astrologers Chris Brennan and Austin Coppock.

We spend the first hour talking about the astrology behind events that happened in the news in July, and then in the second hour we do a deep dive into the astrology of August.  

August is mainly centered on an eclipse season, which begins the first week of the month with a solar eclipse in Leo, and is followed later in the month by lunar eclipse in Pisces. 

Early in the month Venus enters Libra, which is the sign that it will later retrograde back to in October, and it begins its shadow degree phase by the end of August. 

A Mars-Saturn square begins building mid-month, and eventually culminates on the final day of August at the same time that a Jupiter-Saturn trine goes exact. 

This is episode 542 of The Astrology Podcast.
